calledBack.description: Whether the callback URL has been invoked.

lastDeliveredAt.description: Unix timestamp of the last delivery attempt, or 0.

user.description: User key or group key to send the message to.

message.description: Message body to push through Pushover.
message.example: Backup of database \"example\" finished in 16 minutes.

device.description: Optional device name to target instead of all active devices.

sound.description: Sound name to override the recipient's default tone.

url.description: Supplementary URL to show with the message.

urlTitle.description: Optional label shown for the supplementary URL.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp to display instead of the receipt time.

ttl.description: Seconds before the message expires and is deleted automatically.

html.description: Set to 1 to enable HTML formatting.

monospace.description: Set to 1 to enable monospace formatting.

retry.description: Seconds between retries for emergency-priority messages.

expire.description: Maximum retry window in seconds for emergency-priority messages.

callback.description: Public callback URL that Pushover calls when an emergency message is acknowledged.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags stored with an emergency receipt for later cancellation.

attachmentType.description: MIME type for the Base64 attachment.

receipt.description: Emergency receipt identifier returned for priority-2 messages.

status.description: API status. Returns 1 when the message request succeeds.
